WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT il.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price
  FROM InvoiceLine AS il
  JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
  JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
  GROUP BY il.InvoiceId, c.Country
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_unit_price) AS overall_avg
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT s1.InvoiceId, s1.Country, s1.avg_unit_price,
         s1.avg_unit_price - s2.overall_avg AS deviation
  FROM step1 AS s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 AS s2
  WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT Country, AVG(deviation) AS country_avg_deviation
  FROM step3
  GROUP BY Country
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT s3.InvoiceId, s3.Country, s3.avg_unit_price, s3.deviation,
         s3.deviation - s4.country_avg_deviation AS adjusted_deviation,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s3.deviation - s4.country_avg_deviation DESC) AS rnk
  FROM step3 AS s3
  JOIN step4 AS s4 ON s3.Country = s4.Country
)
SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_unit_price, deviation, adjusted_deviation
FROM step5
WHERE rnk <= 10
ORDER BY adjusted_deviation DESC
